D1_inputs: 513 raw spectral bins (0-5120 Hz inclusive, 10 Hz step); no device field (lrate, llevel), no identifier, no date and none of the 20 MAX columns is ever an input to an acoustic model
D1_normalisation: none for tree models; StandardScaler (fit on the training fold only) for logistic regression and MLP

D2_D3_audio.bandpass: Butterworth order 5, zero-phase, 100 Hz to min(5000 Hz, 0.99 x Nyquist)
D2_D3_audio.window: 1 s; 'minstd' = lowest-standard-deviation window on a quarter-window hop (2023 rule); controls: random/first/full
D2_D3_audio.features: mel spectrogram (n_fft=2048, hop=512, n_mels=96, power 2, dB re max); per-band mean and std (192) + 7 spectral descriptors = 199 values
D2_D3_audio.D3_read: PCM_32 little-endian mono 8 kHz, first 240 000 samples

models.tuning: none: library defaults except the values listed; identical settings under every protocol, so only the protocol varies

pretrained_checkpoints.pooling: mean and std over time -> 1536 values; frozen; logistic-regression probe
